title: Restocking Fee Entries on Grade B Return Lines
content:
**Returns & Exchanges — desk action reference: restocking fees on grade B lines.**

## The rule

Once a return is in status inspected, the returns desk withholds one restocking fee for each order line with units graded B (unworn, tags detached), charged on that line's units graded B. A Store Credit Return, a Standard Return and a Gift Return carry it; an exchange or a Quality Issue Return never does. Each fee is entered on the return as a restocking fee entry on its line and lowers what is owed to the customer.

A restocking fee is worked out only after the line it is charged on carries the credit entry for its accepted units. So long as the line shows no credit entry for its accepted units, no restocking fee is worked out for it.

| Return type | Restocking fee on grade B lines |
|---|---|
| Standard Return, Store Credit Return, Gift Return | Withheld, one per line with units graded B |
| Size Exchange, Instant Exchange, Quality Issue Return | Never |

## What the action does

`assess_restocking_fee_49fe3caa` enters, on the return's money ledger, one restocking fee for one booked order line, dated today. The fee lowers what is owed to the customer on the return by its amount. After the call the fee appears among the return's settlement entries as a restocking fee on that line.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side action of the returns desk, outside the standing tool list: the agent unlocks it by its exact name, `assess_restocking_fee_49fe3caa`, and then calls it, once per line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_id` | The RMA number of the return carrying the grade B units, as shown by the return lookup | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `booked_line_id` | The reference number of the order's booking line the fee is charged on, as shown on the return's inspection entries | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `fee_amount_usd` | The restocking fee withheld for the line | USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when the fee is fully waived; recorded as a deduction |

## What comes back

- **Success:** a confirmation sentence naming the new fee entry reference (a reference beginning "rs"), the RMA number, the booking line and the fee withheld in USD with 2 decimal places. The entry reference means the fee was booked.
- **Error:** when no return exists under the RMA number given, the action answers "Error: no return" with that number and records nothing.
